#Read in the da.CpGs file and the da.methylome_pheno file
```{r setup, include=FALSE}


da.methylome_pheno
View(da.methylome_pheno)
colnames(da.methylome_pheno)

da.CpGs
```

#Extract cpg sites that is significant from the EWAS analysis
```{r}
ewas_reg_cpgs <- da.CpGs_temp[, c("cg21711214", "cg21084702", "cg17564074", "cg07839457", "cg12828896", "cg03425812", "id")]
View(ewas_reg_cpgs)

cpg_vars <- setdiff(colnames(ewas_reg_cpgs), "id")

#inverse normal transform the cpg value for analysis to avoid extreme beta coefficients
ewas_reg_cpgs_int <- ewas_reg_cpgs
for (cpg in cpg_vars) {
  ranks <- rank(ewas_reg_cpgs[[cpg]], na.last = "keep") 
  n <- sum(!is.na(ranks))
  ewas_reg_cpgs_int[[cpg]] <- qnorm((ranks - 0.5) / n)
}

#Check and compare distribution of CPG before and after the inverse normal transformation
summary(ewas_reg_cpgs_int[cpg_vars])
par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
for (cpg in cpg_vars) {
  hist(ewas_reg_cpgs[[cpg]], main = paste(cpg, "Original"), xlab = "", col = "lightblue")
  hist(ewas_reg_cpgs_int[[cpg]], main = paste(cpg, "INT"), xlab = "", col = "lightgreen")
}

View(ewas_reg_cpgs_int)

#Extract outcomes of interest and covariates for the regression analysis
ewas_reg_outcome <- da.methylome_pheno[,c("id","egfrcrcys_v5","GENDER51","CENTER","V5AGE51","RACEGRP51", "acr_v5", "SeqId_10574_10","SeqId_3485_28")]
View(ewas_reg_outcome)

ewas_merged <- merge(ewas_reg_outcome, ewas_reg_cpgs_int, by = "id")
View(ewas_merged)

incidents <- read_dta("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/inc_esrd_by20.dta")
View(incidents)
colnames(incidents)

# Merge using a left join: keep all rows in ewas_merged
ewas_merged <- merge(ewas_merged, incidents, by = "id", all.x = TRUE)

#check how many incidental CKD after visit 5
table(ewas_merged$inc_esrd50crcys_def1_v5) # 94 new cases
table(ewas_merged$inc_esrd50_def1_v5)
table(ewas_merged$inc_esrd50crcys_def1_v5)

```

#Regression analysis

#CpGs and Incidental CKD
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}


cpg_int_vars <- c("cg21711214", "cg21084702", "cg17564074", 
                  "cg07839457", "cg12828896", "cg03425812")


# Initialize list to store results
cox_results_list <- list()

# Loop through each CpG and run Cox model
for (cpg in cpg_int_vars) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(fu_esrd50_def1_v1, inc_esrd50crcys_def1_v5) ~", 
                              cpg, "+ V5AGE51 + GENDER51 + CENTER + RACEGRP51"))
  
  model <- coxph(formula, data = ewas_merged)  # use your merged dataset with time and event
  
  summary_model <- summary(model)
  
  if (cpg %in% rownames(summary_model$coefficients)) {
    coef_row <- summary_model$coefficients[cpg, ]
    
    cox_results_list[[cpg]] <- data.frame(
      CpG = cpg,
      Beta = coef_row["coef"],
      HR = exp(coef_row["coef"]),
      HR_CI_lower = exp(coef_row["coef"] - 1.96 * coef_row["se(coef)"]),
      HR_CI_upper = exp(coef_row["coef"] + 1.96 * coef_row["se(coef)"]),
      StdError = coef_row["se(coef)"],
      zValue = coef_row["z"],
      pValue = coef_row["Pr(>|z|)"]
    )
  }
}

# Combine into a results data frame
cox_cpg_results <- do.call(rbind, cox_results_list)

# View results
print(cox_cpg_results)

## Conduct model check to ensure the loop captures the correct coefficients
model_check <- coxph(Surv(fu_esrd50_def1_v1, inc_esrd50crcys_def1_v5) ~ cg21711214 + V5AGE51 + GENDER51 + CENTER + RACEGRP51, data=ewas_merged) 
summary(model_check) #Confirmed the coefficients, SE and P value were captured correctly.



```

## CpGs and Incidental CKD - overall, stratified by race.
```{r}
library(survival)

cpg_int_vars <- c("cg21711214", "cg21084702", "cg17564074", 
                  "cg07839457", "cg12828896", "cg03425812")

# Initialize list to store all results
cox_results_list <- list()

# Loop over CpGs and run Cox models for each stratum
for (cpg in cpg_int_vars) {
  # Define formula
  formula_str <- paste("Surv(fu_esrd50_def1_v1, inc_esrd50crcys_def1_v5) ~", 
                       cpg, "+ V5AGE51 + GENDER51 + CENTER")
  formula <- as.formula(formula_str)

  # --- Overall model ---
  overall_model <- coxph(update(formula, . ~ . + RACEGRP51), data = ewas_merged)
  overall_summary <- summary(overall_model)
  if (cpg %in% rownames(overall_summary$coefficients)) {
    coef_row <- overall_summary$coefficients[cpg, ]
    cox_results_list[[paste0(cpg, "_overall")]] <- data.frame(
      CpG = cpg,
      Strata = "Overall",
      Beta = coef_row["coef"],
      HR = exp(coef_row["coef"]),
      HR_CI_lower = exp(coef_row["coef"] - 1.96 * coef_row["se(coef)"]),
      HR_CI_upper = exp(coef_row["coef"] + 1.96 * coef_row["se(coef)"]),
      StdError = coef_row["se(coef)"],
      zValue = coef_row["z"],
      pValue = coef_row["Pr(>|z|)"]
    )
  }

  # --- White only ---
  white_model <- coxph(formula, data = subset(ewas_merged, RACEGRP51 == "W"))
  white_summary <- summary(white_model)
  if (cpg %in% rownames(white_summary$coefficients)) {
    coef_row <- white_summary$coefficients[cpg, ]
    cox_results_list[[paste0(cpg, "_White")]] <- data.frame(
      CpG = cpg,
      Strata = "White",
      Beta = coef_row["coef"],
      HR = exp(coef_row["coef"]),
      HR_CI_lower = exp(coef_row["coef"] - 1.96 * coef_row["se(coef)"]),
      HR_CI_upper = exp(coef_row["coef"] + 1.96 * coef_row["se(coef)"]),
      StdError = coef_row["se(coef)"],
      zValue = coef_row["z"],
      pValue = coef_row["Pr(>|z|)"]
    )
  }

  # --- Black only ---
  black_model <- coxph(formula, data = subset(ewas_merged, RACEGRP51 == "B"))
  black_summary <- summary(black_model)
  if (cpg %in% rownames(black_summary$coefficients)) {
    coef_row <- black_summary$coefficients[cpg, ]
    cox_results_list[[paste0(cpg, "_Black")]] <- data.frame(
      CpG = cpg,
      Strata = "Black",
      Beta = coef_row["coef"],
      HR = exp(coef_row["coef"]),
      HR_CI_lower = exp(coef_row["coef"] - 1.96 * coef_row["se(coef)"]),
      HR_CI_upper = exp(coef_row["coef"] + 1.96 * coef_row["se(coef)"]),
      StdError = coef_row["se(coef)"],
      zValue = coef_row["z"],
      pValue = coef_row["Pr(>|z|)"]
    )
  }
}

# Combine all results into one data frame
cox_cpg_results_all <- do.call(rbind, cox_results_list)

# View the combined results
print(cox_cpg_results_all)

```


## CPG and eGFR

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

# Initialize a list to store results
results_list <- list()

# Loop through each CpG and run linear regression
for (cpg in cpg_sites) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste("egfrcrcys_v5 ~", cpg, "+ V5AGE51 + GENDER51 + CENTER + RACEGRP51"))
  model <- lm(formula, data = ewas_merged)
  model_summary <- summary(model)
  
  # Extract CpG row
  coef_row <- model_summary$coefficients[cpg, ]
  
  # Store results in a data frame
  results_list[[cpg]] <- data.frame(
    CpG = cpg,
    Beta = coef_row["Estimate"],
    StdError = coef_row["Std. Error"],
    tValue = coef_row["t value"],
    pValue = coef_row["Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
}

# Combine all into one data frame
egfr_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

# View the result
print(egfr_results)


```
## CPG and eGFR - overall and stratified by race

```{r}
# Initialize list to store all results
egfr_results_list <- list()

# Loop through each CpG site
for (cpg in cpg_sites) {
  
  # Define base formula
  base_formula <- as.formula(paste("egfrcrcys_v5 ~", cpg, "+ V5AGE51 + GENDER51 + CENTER"))

  ## --- Overall model (adjusted for race) ---
  overall_model <- lm(update(base_formula, . ~ . + RACEGRP51), data = ewas_merged)
  overall_summary <- summary(overall_model)
  if (cpg %in% rownames(overall_summary$coefficients)) {
    coef_row <- overall_summary$coefficients[cpg, ]
    egfr_results_list[[paste0(cpg, "_Overall")]] <- data.frame(
      CpG = cpg,
      Strata = "Overall",
      Beta = coef_row["Estimate"],
      StdError = coef_row["Std. Error"],
      tValue = coef_row["t value"],
      pValue = coef_row["Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  }

  ## --- White only model ---
  white_model <- lm(base_formula, data = subset(ewas_merged, RACEGRP51 == "W"))
  white_summary <- summary(white_model)
  if (cpg %in% rownames(white_summary$coefficients)) {
    coef_row <- white_summary$coefficients[cpg, ]
    egfr_results_list[[paste0(cpg, "_White")]] <- data.frame(
      CpG = cpg,
      Strata = "White",
      Beta = coef_row["Estimate"],
      StdError = coef_row["Std. Error"],
      tValue = coef_row["t value"],
      pValue = coef_row["Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  }

  ## --- Black only model ---
  black_model <- lm(base_formula, data = subset(ewas_merged, RACEGRP51 == "B"))
  black_summary <- summary(black_model)
  if (cpg %in% rownames(black_summary$coefficients)) {
    coef_row <- black_summary$coefficients[cpg, ]
    egfr_results_list[[paste0(cpg, "_Black")]] <- data.frame(
      CpG = cpg,
      Strata = "Black",
      Beta = coef_row["Estimate"],
      StdError = coef_row["Std. Error"],
      tValue = coef_row["t value"],
      pValue = coef_row["Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  }
}

# Combine all results into one data frame
egfr_results_all <- do.call(rbind, egfr_results_list)

# View results
print(egfr_results_all)

```

#CpGs and log-transformed UACR
```{r}


ewas_merged$log_acr_v5 <- log(ewas_merged$acr_v5)

# Initialize results list
results_list <- list()

# Loop through each CpG and run linear regression
for (cpg in cpg_sites) {
  # Create model formula
  formula <- as.formula(paste("log_acr_v5 ~", cpg, "+ V5AGE51 + GENDER51 + CENTER + RACEGRP51"))
  
  # Fit model
  uacr_model <- lm(formula, data = ewas_merged)
  
  # Print model summary
  cat("\n==========\nLinear regression for", cpg, "\n")
  print(summary(uacr_model))
  
  # Extract model summary
  uacr_summary <- summary(uacr_model)
  
  # Only proceed if CpG is in model
  if (cpg %in% rownames(uacr_summary$coefficients)) {
    coef_row <- uacr_summary$coefficients[cpg, ]
    
    # Store results
    results_list[[cpg]] <- data.frame(
      CpG = cpg,
      Beta = coef_row["Estimate"],
      StdError = coef_row["Std. Error"],
      tValue = coef_row["t value"],
      pValue = coef_row["Pr(>|t|)"]
    )
  } else {
    warning(paste("CpG", cpg, "not found in model coefficients"))
  }
}

# Combine into one data frame
uacr_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

# View results
print(uacr_results)

```
